design_goal: Define the minimum evidence-bearing structure required before any simulator may be called reality-calibrated Japanese keirin. This file does not implement a generator, choose a model winner, fit coefficients, consume real outcomes, or authorize validation.
core_principle: REALISTIC means source-supported structural/statistical constraints with provenance and uncertainty, not visual plausibility or candidate recoverability.

initial_scope_policy.reason: Japanese keirin contains materially different grade, field-size and rule regimes. A single universal generator should not be assumed.

first_possible_implementation_slice_cand.note: This is a deliberately narrow candidate slice because current official programs support seven-rider FI/FII structures. It is not claimed to represent all keirin and is not authorized for execution by this design.

official_structural_support: Japanese track lengths include approximately 333/335/400/500m classes
bank/wind context is decision-relevant in official guidance
B_VENUE_AND_ENVIRONMENT.calibration_rule: Venue geometry may use OFFICIAL_MASTER. Weather/wind must use decision-time observations or explicit ASSUMPTION_RANGE; never silently reuse engineering Gaussian priors as reality distributions.

C_PERSISTENT_RIDER_IDENTITY.required_property: The same rider persists through time; races must not create independent anonymous replacement riders when making reality claims.

D_LONGITUDINAL_PRE_HISTORY.semantics: These are historical PRE statistics, not direct latent ability sensors.
D_LONGITUDINAL_PRE_HISTORY.hard_rule: Every historical value must be the value available before that race's decision cutoff. Current/latest profile values may not be backfilled into historical races.
D_LONGITUDINAL_PRE_HISTORY.synthetic_score_rule: latent_skill + iid Gaussian noise may remain in ENGINEERING worlds but is prohibited from being labeled a reality model of official competition score.

hard_rules: withdrawn/inactive riders must be reconciled before actionable line state
expected and leg-show-observed line states may not be silently mixed
line-dependent model must fail closed when regime or line provenance is unproven

reality_supported_concepts: line cooperation exists in original-line keirin
front/self-powered and chasing/bante roles are asymmetric
locality/relationships and rider style can matter to line formation
blocking, switching, competition for position and line disruption exist
F_ENDOGENOUS_LINE_FORMATION.current_engineering_gap: Current digital_twin_v1 randomly shuffles line membership and then samples style conditional on line position.
F_ENDOGENOUS_LINE_FORMATION.reality_design_requirement: Reality-calibrated line formation must condition on persistent rider/context information rather than random car-number membership alone.

G_RACE_DYNAMICS.anti_affinity_rule: No candidate architecture may define the only truth mechanism. Reality-oriented conclusions require multiple plausible truth mechanisms or source-supported ranges that are chosen before candidate evaluation.
G_RACE_DYNAMICS.W1_rule: Symmetric arithmetic mean line uplift and coefficient 0.16 may be retained only as an ENGINEERING fixture; they are not default reality mechanics.
G_RACE_DYNAMICS.W2_rule: same-line/follower/chain truth may remain an ENGINEERING recoverability fixture; its predicate family is not default reality truth.

H_OUTCOME_AND_PROBABILITY_OBJECT.rule: Do not select the reality truth generator because C0/C1/N1/PEER performs best against it.

calibration_target_registry_v0.target: line effect / tactical interaction effect sizes

official_source_anchors.topic: rider introduction / leg-show line observation before start
race-card competition score and historical-stat semantics
2026 men's KEIRIN ADVANCE international fixed-pacer regime

anti_circularity_protocol: All reality calibration targets and source classes must be frozen before any candidate is evaluated in the reality family.
Candidate performance may not determine truth-side coefficients, line frequencies, noise scales, or mechanism selection.
Matched/mechanism-recovery controls must be labeled ORACLE_LIKE or ENGINEERING and excluded from reality evidence.
Reality sensitivity must include materially different plausible mechanism families when exact truth is unknown.
Fresh Synthetic seeds do not cure world-specification affinity and must not be treated as doing so.
implementation_exit_criteria: No material reality parameter is silently inherited from W0-W4 engineering priors.
A machine-readable program/regime schema is specified.
Persistent rider identity and longitudinal PRE-stat semantics are specified.
Line lifecycle and decision-cutoff provenance contract is specified.
All unknown material parameters remain UNKNOWN or ASSUMPTION_RANGE rather than invented point estimates.
A separate Owner/governance gate authorizes implementation/execution of the first reality-calibrated generator slice.
